name: Ladakh Bike Adventure
route: Leh → Nubra → Pangong → Hanle → Umling La → Hanle → Leh
description: The best time to visit the Leh Ladakh Tour largely depends on your preferences and the experiences you seek. Ladakh, in northern India, is known for its stunning landscapes, monasteries, and unique culture, but it experiences a wide range of weather conditions due to its high altitude and rugged terrain. Here are the primary considerations for each season For most travelers seeking a more comfortable and accessible Ladakh experience, the best time to visit is during the summer months from May to September. This is when the weather is mildest, and the majority of the region's attractions are open and accessible. However, the shoulder seasons and even winter offer their own distinct and enchanting Ladakh experiences if you're prepared for the challenging weather conditions.
highlights: Double Humped Camel Ride At Sand Dunes
Umling La Highest Motorable Road In World

itinerary.title: Arrival at Leh & Explore Leh Town
itinerary.desc: We arrive in Leh and check in at the hotel. This day is kept light for acclimatisation as Leh altitude is approx.11,500 ft. Free time for self explore Mall Road Market & Leh Palace. Evening is reserved for a short trip briefing and preparation for the journey ahead. Overnight stay in Hotel at Leh. Dinner included

itinerary.title: Ride towards Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.desc: We start riding from Leh towards Nubra Valley, known for its wide landscapes and cold desert terrain. Nubra Valley, located north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges From Leh Town, we ride towards Khardung La Pass, situated at an altitude of 18,380 ft. one of the world’s highest motorable pass in the world. The road then descends into Nubra, with open valleys, sand flats, and distant mountains coming into view. We continue ride till Diskit Monastery, the oldest and largest monastery in Nubra Valley. We visit the magnificent Maitreya Buddha Statue, standing 106 ft tall and overlooking the valley. By evening, we arrive at Hunder Sand Dunes. Time to relax, enjoy a double-humped camel ride, ATV Ride on the sand dunes. Or take in the quiet evening and incredible sunset behind the mountains. After sightseeing, arrival at the stays, complete check-in and rest time. Overnight stay in Nubra Valley. Breakfast and dinner included. Riding Distance: 160 km

itinerary.title: Ride from Nubra Valley to Pangong Lake
itinerary.desc: We begin another adventurous riding day towards magnificent Pangong Lake The route leads to Pangong Tso via the Shyok River or Wari La Pass, both rugged routes commonly used by the army. By evening, we reach Pangong Lake and settle in near the lakeshore. Pangong Tso is a high-altitude (14,270 feet) saline lake located along the Indo–China border. It is about 4 Kms wide and 136 Kms long. Enjoy leisure time around the lake, where you can admire the reflection of the surrounding mountains in the stunning blue lake. Overnight stay near Pangong Lake. Breakfast and dinner included. Riding Distance: 160 km Note: If Pangong Tso is inaccessible due to weather or road conditions, we will return to Leh via an alternate route

itinerary.title: Ride towards Hanle – The Stargazers’ Paradise
itinerary.desc: Today we ride from Pangong Lake towards Hanle, one of Ladakh’s most remote regions. On the way, we will pass the town of Chushul and then stop at the Rezang La War Memorial, paying tribute to the heroes who laid down their lives for their motherland in the 1962 Indo–China War. The ride opens up to vast Changthang landscapes with views of the Black Mountain and endless valleys. On the way, stop for lunch and continue riding through the rugged landscape until we reach the charming village of Hanle. Hanle is renowned as the site of the Indian Astronomical Observatory and India's first Dark Sky Reserve. Thanks to clear skies and minimal light pollution, Hanle is ideal for stargazing and astrophotography. At night, if the skies are clear, we step out to watch the Milky Way light up the sky. Overnight stay in Hanle. Breakfast and dinner included. Riding Distance: 160 km

itinerary.title: Thrilling ride to Umling La Pass | The Highest Motorable Road in the World
itinerary.desc: We start the day with breakfast in Hanle, gearing up for one of the most thrilling rides of the trip. Get ready, ignite your engines, and begin a thrilling ride to the highest motorable road in the world - Umling La! The ride takes us towards Umling La Pass, sitting at around 19,300 ft and known as the highest motorable road in the world. The road between Chisumle and Demchok, often called the Umling La Road, offers raw terrain, sharp climbs, and a true high-altitude riding experience. This road is higher than the Everest Base Camp. Take some time to enjoy the views around Umling La and capture a few memorable pictures. Depending on weather and road conditions, we also ride towards Demchok, a small border village located near the Indus River. On our way back to Hanle, we will cross other highest passes like Photi La (18,124 ft) and Nurbu La (17,328 ft). Overnight stay at Hanle / Nyoma. Breakfast and dinner included. Riding Distance: 150 km approx

itinerary.title: Ride back from Hanle to Leh via Chumathang
itinerary.desc: We begin our journey back to Leh, riding via the scenic Chumathang route. On way we stop at the iconic Mahe Bridge, an important crossing set amid dramatic mountain landscapes. A short break at the Chumathang hot springs, known for their naturally warm, sulphur-rich waters. As we get closer to Leh, we visit Thiksey Monastery, famous for its striking architecture and panoramic valley views. On the way back, we visit Druk Padma Karpo School (popularly known as Rancho’s School from '3 idiots' Movie). By evening, we arrive back in Leh and settle in after the long ride. Overnight stay in Leh. Breakfast and dinner included. Riding Distance: 240 km approx

itinerary.title: Day for Leh local sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Expand/Collapse Icon This day is planned for Sham Valley local sightseeing near Leh. Visit Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, a revered Sikh shrine. Stop at Magnetic Hill, known for its unique optical illusion, here vehicles seem to move uphill on their own. Then visit breathtaking Sangam Point, the confluence of the Indus and Zanskar rivers. We drive back to Leh city by evening and visit Shanti Stupa. Known for its iconic structure that offers panoramic views of Leh and the surrounding mountains. Overnight stay in Leh. Breakfast and dinner included. Note: Sightseeing will be done by tempo traveller / taxi

itinerary.title: Return flight towards hometown
itinerary.desc: This day marks last day of the trip in Ladakh. Check-out from the property after breakfast. If the flight is scheduled later in the day, you can enjoy free time to explore Leh town by self. We conclude our Himalayan adventure with a return flight from Leh. Breakfast included
